Your salary depends on your position, experience, and responsibilities, and consists of: - A competitive base salary - 8% vacation pay, paid out in May - A business success plan (up to 5%) - Do you hold a sales position? If so, you are eligible for a commission plan and possibly a company car 
 Vacation days and leave 
We believe that taking time to recharge is just as important as working hard. That's why we offer the following: - 27 vacation days based on a 40-hour workweek - The option to purchase additional vacation days - The option to exchange up to 4 official holidays for days that better align with your personal beliefs 
This gives you the flexibility to balance your work and personal life in a way that suits you.
